narratives.headline: Twelve-game Wednesday: five unders on the board, led by Jarrett Allen with Mobley out and Tyson doubtful
narratives.briefing: It is a full 12-game slate, and every one of the report's five props is an under, all rated Consider rather than anything stronger. The clearest edge is Jarrett Allen under 9.5 rebounds, where the sim goes under in 87% of games against a DraftKings price that implies 50%. The report has no graded record yet (morning 0-0-0), so treat these as untested; the game-line leans are 12-22 for -11.35u since 2026-11-11 and stay leans only. The market has not moved against any card yet, and every pick is still Holding at its published price. This edition goes out before injury reports are final: we are waiting on Jaylon Tyson (doubtful) for the Cleveland cards, Bam Adebayo (probable, and reported probable by Miami) for Giannis Antetokounmpo, and Patrick Williams (probable) for Josh Giddey.

cards.p|4066328|reb|Under: The model projects 6.6 rebounds on 21.0 minutes against a 9.5 line, and the sim goes under 87% of the time; his minutes are projected down 4.0 with Tyson out. What would make us wrong: without Evan Mobley he has gone under 9.5 in only 8 of 17, and MEM is the #8 softest matchup for center rebounds, so the absence that cuts his minutes also frees up boards. Kill it if the line reaches 8.5 or the price passes −133.
cards.p|3064514|ast|Under: At home he has stayed under 4.5 assists in 16 of 20, the model projects 3.9, and 40% of sims end in a blowout where starters sit late. The risk is the thin margin, with 5 of his last 10 landing within 1 of the number, plus a CHI matchup that is the #7 softest for small-forward assists and 10.0 assists per game in his 2 games against them. This one is priced at +117, so the play-to floor is +108.
cards.p|3032977|ast|Under: He is averaging 5.3 assists over his last 10, the model projects 4.7 on 28.0 minutes, and the sim goes under 80% of the time with a 13-point spread raising blowout risk. What argues against it: MIL is the #2 softest matchup for power-forward assists, and similar players run +10% assists against them. Bam Adebayo is listed probable; if he sits, the model re-prices and Giannis may have the ball more.
cards.p|4871145|ast|Under: The model projects 7.6 assists against 8.5 and the sim goes under 70% of the time on a 26.3-minute projection. The clear failure mode is minutes: in his overs he averaged 33.4 minutes against 25.1 otherwise, so a close game or extra run would break it. Watch Patrick Williams (probable); a change there triggers a re-price.
cards.p|3908809|reb|Under: Without Evan Mobley he has stayed under 4.5 rebounds in 12 of 15, and the model has his rebounds -6% tonight with the sim under 65% of the time. This is a thin one: 5 of his last 10 finished within 1 of the number and MEM is the #4 softest matchup for point-guard rebounds. The play-to window is narrow, good only down to −111.
